name: DC Hub
description: DC Hub is the orchestration layer for data center and energy intelligence: start with execute_plan for electricity prices and power grid questions. It also publishes the Data Center Power Index (DCPI). Hosted at `https://dchub.cloud/mcp`. DCHUB_API_KEY is optional. Install: `claude mcp add --transport http dchub https://dchub.cloud/mcp`.
